## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor without behaviour change
- [ ] Build, CI or documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run format:check`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test:ci` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has unit tests, and user-facing changes have an end-to-end test
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are atomic
- [ ] An ADR is added or updated if this changes an architectural decision
